Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

 

Strategic Account Manager

We are seeking a Strategic Account Manager to own Talos's most consequential client relationships across large asset managers, hedge funds, retail brokers, institutional brokers, and global banks.

These institutions are at a technology inflection point. Their existing OMS, EMS, and custody infrastructure was built for traditional asset classes, not 24/7 digital markets. They are deciding right now which technology partners will take them forward, and most of those decisions will be made before a formal process begins. The mandate of this role is to get ahead of those decisions: understand what each client is trying to build, shape how they think about the problem, and make Talos the obvious answer before alternatives are seriously evaluated.

This is a high-agency individual contributor role. You will own the outcome for your accounts without a team beneath you and without formal authority over the internal stakeholders you need to move. You will partner closely with the Global Head of Revenue and Global Head of Account Management, and work in a matrix relationship with Product, Business Development, and Executive leadership.

 

Responsibilities

Strategic account ownership

  • Own a defined book of Talos's largest strategic accounts across asset managers, hedge funds, institutional and retail brokers, and global banks.

  • Build and maintain a rolling 12-month account plan for each account: stakeholder map, current product footprint, white space, active client initiatives, and a prioritized expansion thesis.

  • Get ahead of client technology decisions including OMS evaluations, custody transitions, and settlement or clearing infrastructure upgrades.

  • Know each client's organization well enough to identify which business units are about to prioritize a digital asset initiative.

Relationship and stakeholder development

  • Build relationships across each account at multiple levels: trading desks, technology, operations, finance, risk, and the C-suite.

  • Identify and develop executive sponsors in business units where Talos does not yet have active engagement. This means initiating conversations, not waiting for introductions.

  • Run structured discovery engagements: map the client's end-to-end workflow, identify operational bottlenecks, and translate those findings into documented product opportunities.

Expansion and growth

  • Identify expansion opportunities across additional product lines, new business units, and adjacent workflows before clients raise them.

  • Qualify tokenization and digital asset initiatives by separating genuine demand from exploratory interest, and build a business case for Talos's involvement before engaging the product team.

  • Prioritize your expansion pipeline. When product resources are constrained, make a reasoned case for which opportunity should move first and why.

  • Drive net-new opportunities surfaced within strategic accounts through the commercial process. Establish clear ownership and maintain client momentum to close.

Product strategy input

  • Serve as the primary connection between strategic client requirements and Talos's product organization. Client problems you surface should become documented product inputs.

  • Evaluate whether a client problem is specific to that account or indicative of a broader market need, and build a structured case before bringing it to the product team.

  • Represent client requirements in internal product discussions with the specificity needed to act on them: current workflow, scale of impact, and competitive risk if left unaddressed.

Cross-functional execution

  • Align Sales, BD, Product, and Executive stakeholders around strategic account opportunities. You will not have organizational authority over any of them. You will need to build the case, create the urgency, and hold people accountable to commitments.

  • Set the agenda for strategic engagements, QBRs, and executive briefings. Prepare the internal team, own what gets communicated, and follow through on every commitment made in the room.

  • Maintain accurate account records in Salesforce: contact roles, account plans, open opportunities, activity history, and health status. Clean records are a prerequisite for cross-functional coordination at this account size.

  • Bring competitive intelligence from client conversations into Talos's GTM and product strategy.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7 or more years of experience in strategic account management, enterprise sales, or client coverage at a market technology vendor, financial institution, or institutional digital asset platform.

  • Direct experience working with or selling into asset managers, hedge funds, institutional brokers, or global investment banks on either the buy side or the sell side.

  • Fluency in institutional trading workflows: OMS, EMS, and PMS platforms; order management and execution; allocations, settlement, and post-trade processes. You can map a client's front-to-back trade lifecycle without asking them to explain it.

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate complex organizations and build relationships at multiple levels simultaneously, without relying on formal introductions or organizational authority to open doors.

  • A track record of identifying expansion opportunities within existing accounts and converting them to commercial outcomes, including cases where you initiated the conversation before the client had a defined need.

  • Operates with high agency. Identifies what needs to happen, builds the internal alignment to make it happen, and drives it to completion without waiting to be directed.

  • Clear executive communication. Can turn a complex client workflow or strategic opportunity into a specific, evidence-based case for clients and internal stakeholders.

Highly valued

  • A background managing strategic relationships at an institutional digital asset firm, covering large asset managers, prime brokers, retail brokers, or global banks.

  • Experience holding roles both inside a financial institution and at a technology vendor. Understanding the operating model from both sides is a meaningful advantage in this role.

  • Understanding of how tokenization and digital asset adoption will affect settlement, custody, and fund operations at large institutions. Deep crypto knowledge is not required, but deep market structure knowledge is.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce for account management, pipeline tracking, and activity logging.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

  • Remote – Europe or US (EST only)

  • Hybrid – Paris or New York

 

Role

Morpho's GTM motion has grown faster than the operations behind it. Pipeline visibility, CRM hygiene, forecasting, and tooling are split across people who all have other jobs, and nobody owns the end-to-end picture. This role owns RevOps outright and builds the systems that help the GTM team close more relevant deals, faster.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own GTM dashboards and KPI reporting so the team tracks what matters and trusts the numbers.

  • Run the GTM tech stack, automations, and AI tooling to keep business developers fast and well informed.

  • Keep the CRM minimal and clean, with stages, hygiene, and processes people actually follow.

  • Build business intelligence and forecasting to set targets that are ambitious and credible, and to spot new trends early.

  • Surface signals from markets and media so business developers can chase, upsell, and close at the right moment.

  • Track rep attribution, productivity, quotas, and territories to keep the team accountable and improving.

  • Own the knowledge base and data management so accurate information is easy to find and reuse.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

  • You are fully up to speed on the Morpho product, protocol, and roadmap, and you understand how the GTM team operates today.

  • You have a prioritized plan for what to build, fix, and delete, and you are already making reps faster.

 

First 3 months

  • You have fixed the biggest gaps and bottlenecks: a cleaner CRM, simpler processes, and the automations, dashboards, and forecasts business developers rely on daily.

  • You are central to productivity assessment, rep attribution, and deal tracking.

 

First 6 months

  • You own the full RevOps stack and bridge GTM and Finance.

  • Leadership has full visibility into the business to make better decisions, and you lead entire projects end to end.

 

Must Have Skills & Experience

  • DeFi native: you use onchain products and understand how protocols and their users behave.

  • Experience as a RevOps, growth engineer, or business analyst at a B2B startup.

  • Tech or software background: comfortable building automations and reasoning about connected systems.

  • Strong with data: cleaning, modeling, analyzing, and reporting it accurately.

  • Business mindset with a critical eye: you challenge metrics and simplify by default.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: doesn't wait to be told.

  • Clear and crisp async communication.

  • Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous contexts.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

Description

In 2024, eToro acquired Spaceship, strengthening eToro's presence in the Australian market and expanding into the superannuation and long-term savings sector. eToro has created an intuitive Social Trading platform that gives traders and investors access to global stock markets, with over 40 million users worldwide across 75+ countries. This brings exciting opportunities for integration and growth across the region. At Spaceship, we're on a mission to transform the way people think about and invest their money. Since 2017, we've grown to more than 200,000 members and surpassed $1.9 billion in funds under management.

We offer three core products:

  • Spaceship Super – a superannuation fund designed for members who want a simpler, more transparent approach to retirement savings
  • Spaceship Voyager – managed investment portfolios tailored to different investing timeframes and risk appetites
  • Spaceship US Investing – a self-directed brokerage platform for members wanting direct access to US markets

We’re an AI-first company. That means AI isn’t an add-on – it’s built into how we work, how we build, and how we support our customers. We’re looking for people who share our belief that AI, used thoughtfully, makes financial services faster, smarter, and more human.

What will you be doing?

For a fintech business built on trust, our Customer Support team is essential. You'll be the frontline of that trust – the person members turn to when they have questions, the voice that solves problems, and the ear that captures insights for the broader business.

You'll join a dedicated CX team supporting members across all Spaceship products. Your day-to-day responsibilities include:

  • Handling member enquiries via email, chat, and phone – answering questions about account features, product functionality, account management, and transactional issues
  • Solving account-specific problems – assisting with deposits, withdrawals, account updates, identity verification, and other operational queries
  • Managing complaints and feedback – handling complaints professionally and compassionately, escalating appropriately to compliance and management
  • Providing informed support – drawing on product knowledge, internal systems, and escalation pathways to give members accurate, timely answers
  • Supporting product and operational improvements – connecting member feedback with the business to drive insights and iterations
  • Maintaining compliance standards – ensuring all communications align with financial services regulations, ASIC guidance, and Spaceship's policies
  • Embracing AI tools – using AI-powered support tools to resolve customer enquiries faster, improve response quality, and free up time for complex, high-value interactions

You'll have access to internal tools that enable you to support members effectively and escalate complex issues to the right teams.


Requirements

Essential Requirements

  • 2+ years in B2C customer support, customer success, or customer-facing roles in a professional services or financial services environment
  • Experience with customer support platforms (CRM, ticketing systems, live chat, phone systems)
  • Solid understanding of financial products and services – superannuation, managed investments, and/or trading platforms are a plus
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly in writing and verbally
  • Strong attention to detail and compliance awareness
  • AI-curious – you’re excited about how AI is changing customer support and want to be at the forefront of that shift, not just along for the ride
  • Full working rights in Australia

You'll thrive if you are:

  • Curious and thorough – you dig into problems, ask good questions, and follow through until they're resolved
  • Empathetic and patient – you understand that members come from different backgrounds with different levels of financial literacy, and you meet them where they are
  • Proactive and resourceful – you don't wait to be told what to do; you identify gaps and bring solutions
  • A clear communicator – you can explain complex processes in plain language without being condescending
  • Collaborative – you work well with a small, distributed team and escalate effectively to other departments
  • Committed to continuous learning – fintech and financial services move fast; you stay curious and adapt
  • Detail-oriented with strong systems thinking – you spot errors and understand how changes in one area affect others

Nice to have (we can help you develop):

  • RG146 accreditation or willingness to obtain it – we'll support the right candidate
  • Experience in fintech, banking, or investment platforms
  • Experience managing sensitive or emotionally charged interactions (complaints, disputes, member distress)
  • Familiarity with superannuation regulations or ASIC guidance

Perks and benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Flexibility – 2 days per week working from home
  • Health and wellness benefits
  • Professional development opportunities including financial services training and accreditations
  • Exposure to product development – your feedback directly influences how we build for members
  • Be part of a growing fintech company with global reach (eToro ecosystem) and local focus
  • Access to AI tools, training, and a culture that actively encourages experimenting with new technology

Location and logistics

Sydney office-based with hybrid flexibility (2 days remote per week). We're located in the CBD and easy to access via public transport. Full working rights in Australia required.

About Morpho

Morpho is a leading Decentralized Finance (DeFi) lending protocol backed by a16z crypto, Paradigm, Ribbit Capital, Apollo, Vaneck, Coinbase Ventures, Variant and 50 others to build an open credit network giving anyone, anywhere, access to the best possible terms. Morpho is experiencing exponential adoption, with over billion in deposits on the network and used by institutional clients including Bitwise, Galaxy, and Anchorage Digital and the largest crypto exchanges, such as Coinbase, Binance, and Kraken. Now, Morpho is scaling its team of contributors to establish itself as the open credit network, not just of DeFi, but of the world.

 

Why Morpho Exists

Everyone has the potential to build something great for the world. But fulfilling that ambition almost always requires more: people willing to trust you with their capital. Yet access to capital still depends on where you live, who you know, and which institutions are willing to trust you. Even when capital is available, it sits fragmented across disconnected networks and hidden behind intermediaries. The result is a system that fails most of the people it should serve. Borrowers overpay. Lenders earn less than they should. Many are shut out entirely, not because they are unworthy of credit, but because today's infrastructure was never built to connect them. Morpho exists to solve this. Full article here.

Location

  • Remote – Europe or US (EST only)

  • Hybrid – Paris or New York

 

Role

Morpho's GTM motion has grown faster than the operations behind it. Pipeline visibility, CRM hygiene, forecasting, and tooling are split across people who all have other jobs, and nobody owns the end-to-end picture. This role owns RevOps outright and builds the systems that help the GTM team close more relevant deals, faster, working directly within the Business Operations team, directly under the Head of BizOps.

 

Responsibilities

  • Own GTM dashboards and KPI reporting so the team tracks what matters and trusts the numbers.

  • Run the GTM tech stack, automations, and AI tooling to keep business developers fast and well informed.

  • Keep the CRM minimal and clean, with stages, hygiene, and processes people actually follow.

  • Build business intelligence and forecasting to set targets that are ambitious and credible, and to spot new trends early.

  • Surface signals from markets and media so business developers can chase, upsell, and close at the right moment.

  • Partner with GTM leadership and Finance on comp design, quota setting, and territory assignment.

  • Own the knowledge base and data management so accurate information is easy to find and reuse.

 

What Success Looks Like

First 30 days

  • You are fully up to speed on the Morpho product, protocol, and roadmap, and you understand how the GTM team operates today.

  • You have a prioritized plan for what to build, fix, and delete, and you are already making reps faster.

 

First 3 months

  • You have fixed the biggest gaps and bottlenecks: a cleaner CRM, simpler processes, and the automations, dashboards, and forecasts business developers rely on daily.

  • You are central to productivity assessment, rep attribution, and deal tracking.

 

First 6 months

  • You own the full RevOps stack and bridge GTM and Finance.

  • Leadership has full visibility into the business to make better decisions, and you lead entire projects end to end.

 

Must Have Skills & Experience

  • DeFi native: you use onchain products and understand how protocols and their users behave.

  • Experience as a RevOps, growth engineer, or business analyst at a B2B startup.

  • Tech or software background: comfortable building automations and reasoning about connected systems.

  • Strong with data: cleaning, modeling, analyzing, and reporting it accurately.

  • Finance experience

  • Business mindset with a critical eye: you challenge metrics and simplify by default.

  • Strong ownership and autonomy: doesn't wait to be told.

  • Clear and crisp async communication.

  • Comfort operating in fast-changing, ambiguous contexts.

  • Team-first mindset, low ego.

Perks & Benefits

We design benefits around deep work and growth, so you can do the best work of your career. Expect fair, top-tier compensation, real flexibility, time together in Paris, great health coverage, and support to keep learning.

 

Equal Opportunity

We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and hire based on talent, potential, and values alignment.

  • Build, lead, and mentor a multi-tiered fraud organization — analysts, investigators, and managers — establishing career progression frameworks with clear advancement criteria

  • Work closely with the Executive Team and regulators to stay ahead of emerging fraud trends, techniques, and technologies across the payments and banking industry, directing in-depth analysis to proactively identify and close vulnerabilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain payments and banking fraud policies, rule frameworks, and control processes across all products

  • Maintain Risk assessment, mitigation, Governance and Audit controls

  • Lead comprehensive risk assessments and implement preventive controls that support governance, audit, and regulatory requirements

  • Oversee payments and banking fraud detection systems and tools, and own escalation pathways for complex or novel fraud cases in partnership with Legal, Compliance, and Customer Support

  • Ensure the analyst team maintains SLA and QA standards across high-volume, real-time alert queues

  • Serve as the primary point of coordination between payments and banking Fraud Operations and Customer Support, Compliance, Legal, Product, and Security

  • Direct data analysis and reporting on fraud and payment KPIs, delivering clear, actionable reporting on a daily, weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadence to executive leadership

  • Apply a consistent global coverage standard across all markets, ensuring they are proactively tracked and embedded into policy rather than addressed reactively

What you bring

  • 10+ years of experience in banking, payment processing, or fraud risk management, including experience building or leading a fraud team

  • Demonstrated experience managing both strategic fraud/payments programs and front-line, high-volume analyst operations

  • Proven track record with Card, Third-Party, and Peer-to-Peer payment fraud, along with relevant banking regulatory and compliance frameworks

  • Working knowledge of UK and other non-US regulatory regimes (e.g., FCA, PSR) relevant to fraud, payments, and banking; experience operating under, or reporting to, a UK/EU regulator strongly preferred given the team's non-US footprint

  • Strong understanding of blockchain technology, cryptocurrencies, and associated fraud risks preferred

  • Solid grounding in data analytics and reporting, with a track record of using data-driven insight to guide decisions

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional and executive stakeholders

  • Experience developing career frameworks, coaching managers, and scaling operational teams

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Computer Science, Business Administration, Finance) preferred

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth, and rapidly evolving industry

About the Opportunity

Every transaction we process requires a real-time decision. Declining a legitimate transaction leaves a customer stuck at the point of purchase, while approving a fraudulent one carries a direct cost.

This role owns the decisioning system and underlying platform. From the serving path and feature infrastructure to the underlying models and the machinery required to make safe, live updates. You will continuously improve the platform and our day to day workflows, rather than treating these as secondary projects.

As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will hold a hands-on technical position. You will be part of a team that builds, ships, and maintains the entire machine learning lifecycle.

Our main focus is fraud detection and prevention, an adversarial domain where opponents constantly adapt and feedback arrives in the form of financial impact. Alongside, this we build broader capabilities to enable machine learning across Moonpay.

Lead through ambiguity

  • Set the technical bar through rigorous reviews, clear standards, and lasting engineering habits.

Build and scale the platform

  • Maintain alignment between training and serving to ensure models behave in production exactly as they did offline.

  • Scale the platform as volume and model complexity grow, ensuring operational load remains manageable.

  • Own the services that score transactions in-flight, inside a hard latency budget

  • Design the degraded paths: what we answer when the model can't, and who agreed that policy

Ship safely, continuously

  • Mature the replay, shadow and staged-rollout tooling until changing a live model is routine and reversible

  • Own models across their lifecycle, from training through to retirement, and catch decay long before losses confirm it

  • Systems thinking. You view the architecture holistically: identifying failure points, managing graceful degradation, and ensuring the system remains responsive even when dependencies fail. You build the feedback loops that allow a system to learn from its own decisions.

  • Engineering craft. You write code other people are happy to inherit — tested, typed, and correct when events arrive twice, late, or out of order. Adding the next feature to something you built is fast and painless.

  • Pipelines in production. You have owned feature or data pipelines end-to-end, including troubleshooting cases where offline and production metrics diverged and resolving the underlying discrepancies.

  • Decision explainability. You've built systems where the reason for a decision mattered as much as the decision: audit trails, per-layer attribution, llm-driven analyses, or defending a model's behaviour to a non-technical audience.

  • Anomaly detection. You have developed systems to detect novel attack patterns and emerging abuse without existing labels, identifying suspicious behavior relative to historical baselines.

  • Familiarity with our stack: GCP, BigQuery, Bigtable, Memorystore, Vertex AI, Kubernetes.

What is Kalshi?

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

Kalshi sits at the intersection of news, markets, politics, sports, culture, and public debate. The conversation moves quickly, and how we show up in those moments matters.

We’re looking for a highly hands-on Rapid Response comms pro to own how Kalshi engages with fast-moving news, narratives, and public conversations. You’ll monitor the news cycle and online discourse, identify moments where Kalshi should engage, and turn complex topics into clear, compelling narratives that help people understand Kalshi and prediction markets.

This is an execution-heavy role. You won't just develop the strategy—you'll write the response, coordinate the right people, publish the message, and move quickly when the moment demands it.

What You'll Do

  • Own Kalshi’s rapid-response operation across news, social media, and public discourse

  • Monitor breaking news, media coverage, social conversations, and emerging narratives relevant to Kalshi and prediction markets

  • Identify when Kalshi should enter a conversation and determine the right message, channel, and approach

  • Develop clear, compelling narratives around Kalshi, prediction markets, and key industry issues

  • Translate complex financial, regulatory, and industry topics into simple, accessible messaging

  • Draft and execute rapid-response content across Kalshi’s social channels

  • Work with creators, commentators, partners, and other external voices to communicate key messages

  • Partner closely with Communications, Social, Brand, Legal, and leadership on high-priority moments

  • Anticipate emerging narratives and prepare messaging before they become major conversations

  • Track how narratives develop and adapt Kalshi’s response in real time

What You Bring

  • Experience in rapid response, communications, public affairs, media, politics, or another role operating around fast-moving news cycles

  • Exceptional writing skills and strong narrative instincts

  • Deep understanding of social media, news cycles, online discourse, and how narratives spread

  • Excellent judgment around when to engage, when not to engage, and how to communicate in high-pressure situations

  • Ability to quickly understand complicated topics and explain them simply

  • Highly hands-on and comfortable personally writing, posting, coordinating, and executing

  • Ability to move extremely quickly without sacrificing accuracy or judgment

  • Strong understanding of how different audiences, creators, journalists, and online communities consume information

  • Comfortable operating independently with limited direction

  • Strong interest in news, politics, markets, culture, and the conversations shaping the world

Bonus

  • Experience in political campaigns, government, public affairs, journalism, or high-intensity communications environments

  • Experience managing rapid response for a high-profile company, executive, campaign, or organization

  • Existing relationships with creators, commentators, journalists, or other influential voices

  • Experience communicating around controversial or highly scrutinized topics

  • Experience working in financial services, fintech, technology, media, or another regulated industry

  • Deep familiarity with prediction markets and the broader debate surrounding them

  • Experience building monitoring systems or processes for identifying emerging narratives early

NYC Pay Transparency Disclosure

Salary Range: $135,000 to $225,000 annually plus equity and benefits. This salary range is based on the current available market data, and represents the expected salary range for this role. Kalshi has minimal hierarchy and few titles, but has broad ranges of experience represented within roles. Should you have compensation expectations that exceed these bands, we'd love to hear from you and would welcome you to reach out to further discuss.

Our Culture

Meritocracy is at our core, and we value people who take ownership and figure (usually hard) things out. We dream big. We love our craft deeply and are proud of what we put out in the world. We are committed to our vision of building something big… but also useful: a product that brings more truth through the power of markets.

Kalshians are Kalshi’s most important asset: we pick Kalshians carefully, so we trust them fully on day 1.

If you are passionate about what you do and want to use your talents to support our mission and values, we’d love to hear from you.

About Riot Platforms

Riot’s (NASDAQ: RIOT) vision is to be the world’s most trusted platform for powering and building digital infrastructure. Riot’s mission is to empower the future of digital infrastructure by positively impacting the sectors, networks, and communities that we touch. We believe that the combination of an innovative spirit and strong community partnership allows us to achieve best-in-class execution and create successful outcomes.


Who we are

At Riot, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Our team members have unparalleled opportunities to work on groundbreaking initiatives. Through technical excellence and strategic execution, Riot has positioned itself as a leader in the industry driving advancements that continue to set new benchmarks in digital infrastructure. 


We are trailblazers. Problem solvers. People who thrive in fast paced environments, communicate clearly, and bring relentless focus to efficiency and execution.


About The Role

Riot is expanding our footprint into hyperscale data centers for AI and HPC clients, and we’re looking for a Manager, Network Infrastructure to help shape the future of digital infrastructure.


As our Manager, Network Infrastructure, you will lead the design, operation, security, and continuous improvement of Riot’s enterprise network infrastructure across multiple locations. This role is responsible for ensuring the availability, performance, scalability, and security of wired, wireless, WAN, and data center network environments that support corporate, manufacturing, engineering, and operational teams.


This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can set technical direction, manage network priorities, and provide operational oversight while remaining actively engaged in complex troubleshooting, infrastructure projects, and vendor coordination. The ideal candidate is technically strong, detail-oriented, and capable of leading a stable, secure, and high-performing network environment in a fast-paced organization.


This position will be based in Austin, TX with travel to Rockdale, TX as needed.


What you'll be doing

  • Manage, mentor, and develop network engineering resources while maintaining a strong hands-on technical presence.
  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure network architectures that support corporate offices, manufacturing operations, engineering teams, and data center environments.
  • Expert knowledge of enterprise networking, protocols, switching, and network design.
  • Monitor network performance, capacity, availability, and security events; respond to alerts and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Establish and maintain network standards, documentation, diagrams, configurations, operating procedures, and disaster-recovery plans.
  • Lead network troubleshooting and serve as the primary escalation point for complex connectivity, performance, and security issues.
  • Plan and execute network upgrades, site deployments, hardware refreshes, migrations, and infrastructure expansion projects in accordance with established change-management processes.
  • Partner with Systems, Security, Engineering, Software, and Operations teams to ensure network infrastructure meets business, operational, and security requirements.
  • Ensure network security best practices are followed, including access control, segmentation, firewall policy management, secure remote access, patch compliance, and infrastructure hardening.
  • Develop and maintain network monitoring, alerting, and reporting capabilities to provide visibility into network health and performance.
  • Coordinate with field operations, SCADA/OT teams, infrastructure teams, security teams, application teams, service providers, and vendors to deliver stable and secure connectivity.
  • Operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, making sound technical and business decisions to maintain a secure, resilient, and high-performing network environment.


What you'll have

  • Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent enterprise network experience.
  • Track record leading network and NetOps teams in fast-paced, mission-critical environments.
  • Experience administering enterprise firewalls, wireless networks, routers, switches, and secure remote-access solutions.
  • Expert knowledge of enterprise networking—routing protocols, switching, and network design.
  • Experience supporting WAN connectivity, site-to-site VPNs, internet circuits, and relationships with telecommunications providers.
  • Strong knowledge of network security principles, firewall policy management, access control, network monitoring, and incident response.
  • Experience with network monitoring, performance analysis, capacity planning, and complex infrastructure troubleshooting.
  • Experience working in a manufacturing, engineering, industrial, or multi-site enterprise environment is preferred.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities, lead projects, communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, and operate effectively with minimal supervision.
  • Experience with network automation, scripting, and configuration-management tools is preferred.

 

Preferred Certifications (Highly Desired)

  • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) Enterprise, Security, or Data Center.
  • Cisco Certified Internetwork Expert (CCIE).
  • Fortinet Network Security Expert or equivalent firewall/security certification.
  • CompTIA Network+ and/or Security+.
  • ITIL Foundation certification.

 

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience + bonus + sign-on equity grant.
  • Long-Term Growth: Eligible to participate in Riot’s equity incentive programs and share in the success you help build.
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan: Includes a generous company match.
  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Multiple medical plan options, including 100% company-paid plans.
  • Wellness & Lifestyle Perks: Enjoy free gym memberships, pet insurance, childcare discounts, and more to support your life both in and out of work.


Riot is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

  • Standards: Maintain compliance with OSHA regulations and internal safety training.
  • Organization: Keep all work areas clean and free of obstructions to prevent workplace accidents.

Blockstream was founded in 2014 by Dr. Adam Back and a group of fellow cryptographers and engineers passionate about Bitcoin and its potential to change the future of finance. We have become a market leader in Bitcoin security and Layer-2 technologies. Our products are designed to make financial systems more efficient, secure, and robust.

We're seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer embedded directly inside customer engineering teams, writing the code, building the tooling, integrations and configurations needed to get Blockstream's products into production. Additionally you ship what you build back into the core product.

Operating within the Consulting Services organization, the Forward Deployed Engineer partners closely with Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Delivery teams to help customers successfully implement and adopt Blockstream's products.

This is not a traditional configuration or support role. You will spend significant time working directly alongside customer engineering, operations, and technology teams, often onsite, to understand complex banking environments, solve technical challenges, and deliver production-ready solutions. As the technical bridge between customers and Blockstream, you will play a critical role in accelerating customer success while providing valuable implementation insights that continuously improve our products and delivery methodology.


What You'll Be Doing (Responsibilities):

Customer Delivery & Implementation

  • AI-first prototyping: Use AI-assisted development to stand up minimum viable solutions or proof of concepts on short turnaround notice, proving Enterprise Product value early in an engagement and hardening the winning prototypes into use case based playbooks.

  • Tech Pre-Sales: Support Enterprise Sales in technical pre-sales, RFP/RFI and security questionnaire responses; contribute to SOW scoping, effort estimation, and scope-change management.

  • Delivery: Own the technical delivery of Blockstream enterprise software from project kickoff through production deployment and post launch support

  • Financial Institutions: Work directly with financial institutions to understand business processes, operational workflows, and technical environments.

  • Configure, deploy, and optimize Blockstream products based on customer requirements and approved solution designs.

  • Success Criteria: Execute implementation planning, system configuration, testing, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), production deployment, and post-go-live support. Define success criteria, milestones and own implementation.

  • Deliver administrator and end-user enablement sessions to ensure successful customer adoption.

  • Enterprise integration: Integrate with core banking and capital-markets systems.

Engineering & Technical Delivery

  • Controlled environments: Deploy into on-premise, network-isolated, and air-gapped banking environments under formal change control, producing the security and audit evidence that compliance and pen-test reviews require.

  • Design and implement integrations between Blockstream enterprise products and customer systems using required integration interfaces and data pipeline technologies.

  • Troubleshoot complex technical, configuration, and integration challenges throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Work closely with customer engineering teams to ensure secure, scalable, and production-ready deployments.

  • Develop reusable deployment assets, implementation playbooks, technical documentation, and best practices.

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering to resolve product issues and improve implementation quality.

Customer Collaboration

Embed directly with customer teams to gain a deep understanding of their operating environment and technical challenges.

  • Facilitate technical workshops, architecture discussions, and implementation planning sessions.

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Build strong relationships across customer Technology, Operations, Security, and Engineering functions.

Digital Assets Product Improvement Feedback Loop

  • Turn implementation learnings, customer feedback, and product enhancement opportunities into code

  • Identify repeatable deployment patterns across engagements and contribute to standardized implementation methodologies.

  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to shape the roadmap and improve platform capabilities based on real customer implementations.

  • Help accelerate customer time-to-production through continuous improvement of deployment frameworks and best practices.

What We Look for In You (Required Qualifications):

  • 4-8 years of experience in Software Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, Professional Services, Technical Consulting, Implementation Engineering, or Enterprise Software Delivery.

  • Proficiency in at least one systems or backend language (e.g. Python, Go, Rust) sufficient to build and ship integrations, tooling and services independently

  • Experience implementing and deploying enterprise software solutions within complex customer environments.

  • Strong understanding of protocol intermediation, enterprise integration patterns, cloud technologies, security fundamentals and modern software architectures.

  • Experience working directly with enterprise customers throughout implementation and deployment projects.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.

  • Comfortable collaborating across Product Management, Engineering, Enterprise Sales, and Consulting teams.

  • Strong customer-facing communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Self-starter with proven ability to work independently while managing multiple customer engagements.

  • Willingness to travel regularly to customer locations across Europe.

  • Excellent English skills are required

Nice To Haves (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Experience working with financial institutions, like private banking, wealth management, custody, payments, treasury, or capital markets.

  • Background in Bitcoin, blockchain, digital assets, tokenization, or fintech.

  • Experience integrating enterprise software using APIs and modern integration frameworks.

  • Knowledge of cloud platforms, containerized deployments, or infrastructure automation.

  • Familiarity with Layer-2 technologies and digital asset infrastructure.

  • Experience contributing product feedback from customer implementations into engineering roadmaps.


🔒 Stay Safe from Job Scams
All official Blockstream communication will come from an @blockstream.com email address. We will never ask you to share sensitive information or purchase equipment during the hiring process. If in doubt, contact us at hr@blockstream.com. Learn more about avoiding job scams here.

About the role

We are looking to add an Operations Supervisor to our growing Operations Department. As an Operations Supervisor, you will be responsible for managing and coordinating the daily activities of the operations team to ensure efficient and effective workflow. This role involves supervising staff, monitoring processes, implementing procedures, and ensuring compliance with company policies and safety regulations. The Operations Supervisor works closely with other departments to optimize productivity, improve operational efficiency, and meet performance targets. They are also responsible for training and developing team members, troubleshooting operational issues, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. This on-site position is based at our Corsicana, TX facility. 


What you'll be doing

  • Oversee daily operations to ensure safe, efficient, and seamless workflows while maintaining compliance with company policies, safety standards, and industry regulations.
  • Implement and enforce safety protocols to maintain a secure working environment and reduce operational risk.
  • Coordinate and assign tasks across teams to ensure optimal resource allocation, productivity, and timely completion of operational work.
  • Monitor equipment and system performance, troubleshoot issues, and respond quickly to prevent downtime and operational disruptions.
  • Conduct regular inspections to identify hazards, compliance gaps, and opportunities for operational improvement.
  • Lead, manage, and support a team of operators by providing guidance, training, and performance evaluations.
  • Liaise with supervisors and cross-functional departments to ensure smooth site operations, strong communication, and escalation of key updates, challenges, and recommendations to upper management.
  • Maintain accurate operational records, support incident documentation, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and effectiveness.


What you'll have

  • Associate’s degree or equivalent in a technical field, or relevant hands-on experience in an operational environment.
  • 2–4 years of experience in operations, production supervision, or a similar role, with proven team leadership experience.
  • Strong understanding of operational processes, equipment maintenance, troubleshooting, and workflow optimization.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations, compliance standards, and ability to consistently enforce safe work practices.
  • Experience with resource management, including labor, materials, scheduling, and inventory coordination.
  • Familiarity with data collection and performance monitoring to support data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
  • Proficiency with operational software tools such as maintenance management systems, scheduling, reporting, or project management platforms.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage teams, resolve conflict, and perform effectively under pressure.

Global Services is the centre of expertise at Chainalysis — the team that translates our platform, data, and investigative capabilities into real-world impact for customers across law enforcement, national security, financial institutions, and the broader crypto ecosystem.


Chainalysis is seeking a Deployment Strategist to join Global Services as a core technical practitioner. This is not a traditional services or solutions engineering role. Deployment Strategists are embedded technical experts who own the full lifecycle of customer value — from problem discovery and investigation through solution design, deployment, and customer enablement.

The role sits at the intersection of blockchain investigation, data analytics, domain expertise, and customer partnership. You will work directly with customers to understand their mission, conduct investigations, build tailored solutions, and enable customer teams to operationalise Chainalysis independently. Success requires deep investigative capability, genuine domain expertise, technical skill, and the ability to build trusted relationships through credibility — not just communication.

This is the role that makes Chainalysis essential to how our customers operate.

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own end-to-end customer engagements — from discovery through investigation, solution design, deployment, enablement, and ongoing value delivery

  • Conduct blockchain investigations across the Chainalysis platform, applying tracing, OSINT, and analytical techniques to real customer problems

  • Partner directly with customers to understand investigative, intelligence, compliance, or operational objectives and translate them into actionable outcomes

  • Design, build, and maintain custom workflows, notebooks, dashboards, queries, and data models using Chainalysis data and products

  • Enable customers to operate solutions independently — building their capability so that Chainalysis becomes embedded in their operational infrastructure

  • Act as the primary technical and domain advisor for your customers, building trusted relationships through hands-on expertise and credibility

  • Deliver live training, demos, investigative walkthroughs, and technical briefings to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Support pre-sales technical engagement for complex and strategic deals — helping customers understand what's possible and how to get there

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Global Intel, and Sales to influence roadmap and improve offerings based on field intelligence

  • Develop and share domain expertise, investigative techniques, and best practices that raise the capability of the wider GS team

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • Conducted or directly supported cryptocurrency investigations, blockchain intelligence work, or financial crime analysis in an operational environment

  • Deep familiarity with blockchain ecosystems (BTC, ETH, stablecoins, DeFi) and how on-chain data is used in investigations, compliance, or intelligence workflows

  • Delivered customer-facing technical solutions — whether investigative outputs, data products, or analytical workflows — in complex, real-world environments

  • Worked directly with customers in law enforcement, national security, intelligence, compliance, financial crime, or security-focused domains

  • Built insights from large or complex datasets and communicated findings to varied audiences — from analysts to executives

  • Operated successfully in fast-paced, ambiguous environments requiring ownership, adaptability, and sound judgment

  • Excellent English and Hindi

Required Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL for data analysis, transformation, and solution development

  • Experience building notebooks, dashboards, and analytical workflows

  • Solid understanding of data modelling, querying, and working with large datasets

  • Ability to quickly develop deep expertise in Chainalysis data structures, schemas, and products

Domain Expertise

  • Substantive knowledge of at least one domain: financial and cyber crime investigations, sanctions and compliance, fraud, national security, DeFi/protocol security, tax, or private sector risk

  • Understanding of how customers in your domain operate — their workflows, regulatory environment, and what success looks like for them

  • Ability to apply domain knowledge to shape investigation approach, solution design, and customer advisory

Nice to have experience:

  • Direct experience with Chainalysis products

  • Background in law enforcement, intelligence, or military investigations

  • Experience providing expert evidence or supporting legal proceedings

  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks (BSA/AML, sanctions screening, MiCA, Travel Rule)

  • Experience with data engineering tools and platforms (e.g., Databricks, Snowflake, cloud-based analytics)

  • Published research, intelligence products, or thought leadership in blockchain analytics or financial crime

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

Kalshi has defined a new category: prediction markets. Kalshi allows people to trade on the outcome of any events and turn any question about the future into a financial asset. Kalshi fought for years and legalized prediction markets in the US for the first time in history, is currently the fastest growing financial market in America, and has thousands of markets across politics, economics, financials, weather, tech, AI, culture and more.

We believe prediction markets have the potential to be the largest financial market because they turn anything into a financial position.

  • Our vision: well… build the largest financial market on the planet.

  • Our mission: bring more truth to the world through the power of markets.

Our culture is simple: we hire really talented people, work really hard, and enjoy the climb. We are looking for ambitious and exceptional people to join our (relatively small) team to help us build the next generation of financial markets.

Role Roadmap

Kalshi is the first federally regulated prediction market in the U.S., and politics is at the heart of what we do. As we build toward the 2026 Midterms, we're looking for a Politics Growth Intern who lives and breathes political media, knows the landscape inside and out, and wants to help us grow Kalshi's presence at the intersection of politics and markets.

This is not a passive research role. You'll be a real thought partner - helping shape strategy, identifying opportunities, and executing on ideas that put Kalshi in front of the right audiences at the right moments. If you spend your free time tracking poll numbers, following political influencers, and debating race outcomes, this role was made for you.

What You'll Do

  • Help develop and execute Kalshi's politics social media strategy across X and other platforms, with a focus on growing our presence in political communities

  • Assist in identifying and building partnerships with political creators, commentators, journalists, and influencers on both sides of the aisle

  • Serve as a thought partner on growth activation strategies heading into the 2026 Midterms, bringing ideas on how to capture attention during key political moments

  • Track which races, candidates, and political storylines are driving the most engagement on Kalshi and translate that into targeted growth strategy

  • Monitor political social media trends in real time and help the team move quickly when opportunities arise

  • Support cross-functional collaboration with Growth, Markets, and Product team

What You bring

  • Deep passion for politics: you know the key races, the major players, and the influencers shaping the conversation on both sides of the aisle

  • Familiarity with prediction markets and how they work; prior trading experience on Kalshi or other platforms is a plus but not required

  • Strong understanding of political social media

  • A bias toward action and a resourceful, figure-it-out mentality

  • Strong collaborator who works well across teams and communicates clearly

  • Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from an undergraduate or graduate program

What This Role Is

  • A front-row seat to how prediction markets intersect with one of the most consequential political cycles in recent memory

  • A real contributor role: your ideas and work will directly shape Kalshi's politics growth strategy

  • An opportunity to build relationships across the political media landscape

  • A fast-moving, high-ownership internship for someone who wants to do more than make decks

Polymarket operates a CFTC-regulated designated contract market (DCM) and derivatives clearing organization (DCO).   • Demonstrated ability to write clearly and persuasively — comment letters, no-action requests, and customer agreements that are filed or sent with minimal revision

  • (Plus) Familiarity with prediction markets or event contracts

  • Unlimited PTO

About zerohash national trust bank

zerohash national trust bank (zntb) is proposing to establish a nation trust bank with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC) and its application is currently in progress. If approved, zntb would operate as a proposed national trust bank and wholly owned subsidiary of zerohash, a Chicago-based digital asset infrastructure platform that provides regulated API infrastructure for crypto trading, stablecoin payments, tokenized assets, and cross-border settlement to banks, fintechs, brokerages, and payment companies.

zntb is being organized to exercise fiduciary powers and conduct trust company operations in accordance with the National Bank Act and 12 CFR Part 9. The bank’s core activities will include digital asset custody, safekeeping, and related fiduciary services for its clients.

Candidates must be located within a 1-hour driving radius of one of our main office hubs (Chicago, NYC, UK/Amsterdam for EMEA).

About the Job

zerohash national trust bank is seeking a foundational Chief Trust Officer to help build, launch, and operate the bank from the ground up. Reporting directly to the CEO of zntb, the Chief Trust Officer will be the bank’s senior-most fiduciary executive, responsible for, trust administration, fiduciary controls, and organizational performance. This individual will play a pivotal role in completing pre-opening requirements for OCC charter approval, establishing the operational and governance infrastructure required to commence business, and running a safe and sound banking operation thereafter.

The Chief Trust Officer will serve as the lead Fiduciary Officer of the bank, leading all fiduciary and trust staff in fulfilling fiduciary obligations under 12 CFR Part 9, and will be the primary executive accountable for reporting to the zntb Board of Directors on fiduciary activities and compliance with Part 9, in additional to other, compliance, operational KPIs across the organization.

This is a rare opportunity to build a federally chartered trust bank from inception — ideal for a proven operator with fiduciary experience who combines deep trust and custody expertise with the entrepreneurial drive to stand up a new institution.

This fully remote role is open to candidates in the U.S.

Key Responsibilities

Bank Operations Leadership

  • Lead all day-to-day fiduciary functions of zntb, including custody operations, settlement flows, reconciliation, reserve operations, and account administration.
  • Design, implement, and maintain operational playbooks, standard operating procedures, and business continuity frameworks aligned with OCC safety and soundness expectations.
  • Build and manage the bank’s operational infrastructure from pre-opening through steady-state operations, coordinating with engineering, product, finance, and legal teams.
  • Oversee operational readiness for new products, new asset types, new partner integrations, and changes to the bank’s operational scope.
  • Establish and monitor SLAs, exception-handling protocols, and operational uptime standards across all bank functions.

Fiduciary Operations & Trust Administration (12 CFR Part 9)

  • Serve as the senior Fiduciary Officer of zntb, leading the trust and fiduciary staff in the administration of all fiduciary and custodial accounts.
  • Oversee fiduciary recordkeeping, including account setup, asset segregation, ledger accuracy, periodic account reviews, and documentation required under 12 CFR §9.6.
  • Ensure trust operations comply with OCC fiduciary standards, including annual review requirements, internal fiduciary audit protocols, and applicable state trust law.
  • Maintain adequate safeguards and controls over fiduciary assets, including collateral requirements for uninsured fiduciary funds in accordance with 12 CFR Part 9.
  • Implement and enforce policies and procedures governing self-dealing, conflicts of interest, and co-mingling of fiduciary and non-fiduciary assets.
  • Work closely with the Chief Operating Officer to build and monitor controls, reporting and visibility of fiduciary responsibilities.

Board Reporting & Governance

  • Serve as the primary executive responsible for reporting to the zntb Board of Directors on fiduciary activities, controls, and institutional KPIs.
  • Prepare and present regular Board and committee reports covering all fiduciary account activity, reconciliation integrity, vendor performance, operational incidents, and risk metrics.
  • Support the Board in discharging its fiduciary governance obligations under 12 CFR §9.7, including participation in the bank’s audit and risk committees.
  • Maintain the governance calendar and ensure timely production of all required Board materials, reports, and approvals.

Regulatory Compliance & OCC Examination Readiness

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation, operational logs, and evidence repositories in preparation for OCC examinations, fiduciary audits, and supervisory reviews.
  • Implement and maintain OCC-aligned internal control systems across operations, custody, reconciliation, and settlement workflows.

As Manager, GRM AI Transformation, you will help lead the reinvention of how Circle’s Global Risk Management (GRM) organization operates — moving it from today’s manually intensive processes to an AI-native operating model in which intelligent agents run core workflows end to end, and people focus on judgment, oversight, and the highest-stakes decisions. Reporting to the leader of GRM’s AI transformation, you will partner with process owners across compliance, financial crime, security, financial risk, and enterprise risk to define an ambitious vision for every process, challenge long-held assumptions about how the work must be done, and translate that vision into a portfolio of AI applications and reusable capabilities that scale across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of business process transformation, risk management, and applied AI: you will drive change management and the mindset shifts it requires, stand up the shared building blocks and guardrails that make AI safe and responsible, and coordinate closely with Circle’s central AI team and AI leaders across the company to advance an enterprise-wide transformation. Success means a GRM that decouples business growth from headcount, moves at machine speed, and preserves the risk-management discipline and controls that Circle’s customers, regulators, and markets rely on.

  • Lead workshops and working sessions with GRM process owners to reimagine their processes from first principles and define an ambitious AI-native “future state” vision for each one.

  • Challenge long-held assumptions and drive the mindset shift from “today’s processes with AI added on” to processes designed natively around intelligent agents — bringing rigorous business-process-optimization and transformation discipline to the effort.

  • Help build GRM into an AI-native organization whose core processes are led by agents, with people focused on judgment, exceptions, and oversight.

  • Champion consistent execution of Circle's AI Risk Management framework across all GRM AI developments — ensuring every AI-native process is risk-assessed, appropriately controlled, and shipped with the guardrails and human-in-the-loop oversight needed to keep AI safe, responsible, explainable, and auditable.

  • Help shape GRM’s AI-native vision and target architecture, including a foundation of reusable “primitives” — modular capabilities that provide common functionality once and are leveraged by many different business processes rather than rebuilt for each.

  • Champion a “build once, reuse everywhere” model, prioritizing and sequencing these foundational building blocks so they unlock and accelerate the broader portfolio of process-level AI initiatives.

  • Drive the development of the AI applications most pivotal to GRM’s transformation — from scoping and requirements through build, testing, launch, adoption, and measurable impact.

  • Translate risk and compliance domain needs into clear solution designs, success criteria, and outcomes, partnering closely with process owners, builders, and engineering to keep initiatives moving.

  • Partner with Circle’s central AI team and with AI leaders across other (non-GRM) organizations to align on shared platforms, standards, and best practices and to advance enterprise-wide AI transformation.

  • Coordinate and enable GRM’s community of AI drivers and hands-on builders, and represent GRM’s priorities in enterprise AI forums — feeding GRM use cases into shared infrastructure and bringing enterprise capabilities back into GRM.

  • Own and continuously improve GRM-level reporting on the AI transformation — maintaining a clear view of initiatives in flight, progress against roadmap, measurable impact, blockers, and dependencies.

  • Prepare updates and materials for GRM leadership, executive reviews, and risk committees, and keep GRM’s roadmap aligned with the central AI team’s programs and cadence.

Core Requirements:

  • 7+ years of experience in business process transformation, operational excellence, management consulting, product/program management, or a related discipline, including leading process redesign or automation initiatives that changed how work gets done.

  • A demonstrated ability to reimagine and optimize complex business processes — mapping current state, designing a bold future state, and driving the organizational change and mindset shifts required to get there.

  • Strong working fluency with modern AI, including generative AI and agentic / AI-native concepts, and a track record of applying it to real business problems. You do not need to be an ML engineer, but you must be able to think in terms of what AI can do and design processes around it.

  • Experience driving cross-functional initiatives end to end — from vision and scoping through delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

  • Excellent facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to lead workshops, constructively challenge senior process owners, and build alignment across diverse teams.

  • Exposure to risk management, compliance, financial crime, security, or another regulated, control-oriented domain — or the ability to quickly build credibility with risk and compliance stakeholders.

  • Strong program and portfolio management skills, including tracking multiple concurrent initiatives, reporting to leadership, and managing dependencies, roadblocks, and roadmaps.

  • A builder’s mindset and comfort operating in ambiguity, with high autonomy and a bias for action.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to distill complex, technical, and cross-functional work into clear narratives for executives and committees.

  • A strong sense of responsibility for doing things the right way — building AI solutions with appropriate governance, controls, and guardrails from day one.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience in financial services, fintech, crypto / digital assets, or another regulated environment.

  • Hands-on experience building or configuring AI solutions (e.g., agents, LLM workflows, automations) using modern low-code / no-code or AI development tools.

  • Experience partnering with central or shared AI, data, or platform teams and contributing to reusable, enterprise-scale capabilities.

  • Familiarity with AI governance and responsible-AI frameworks (risk-based oversight, human-in-the-loop, explainability, auditability).

  • Background in management consulting, transformation, or operational excellence (e.g., Lean / Six Sigma), at a top firm or on an in-house transformation team.

Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

The Commercial Legal team is at the forefront of Kraken’s global business operations, serving as strategic legal partners across all departments. This lean and dynamic group is responsible for managing a wide range of commercial contracts and supporting the company in its partnerships, procurement, licensing, and vendor relationships. The team plays a key role in enabling Kraken’s rapid innovation and expansion while protecting the business from legal and regulatory risks.

As Assistant General Counsel – Commercial (Partnerships), you will report directly to the Head of Commercial Legal. You will be responsible for leading Kraken’s product partnership commercial legal efforts, working cross-functionally with Product, Sales, Finance, Engineering, and Regulatory teams to craft and launch novel and strategically significant products and partnerships at the most innovative financial exchange in the world.

 

The opportunity

  • Serve as the lead commercial counsel for cutting edge, high visibility product partnerships, driving legal strategy and execution for complex and first-of-their-kind commercial arrangements that support Kraken’s most innovative product initiatives.

  • Act as a strategic partner to the Product, Sales, Engineering, Finance, and Regulatory teams, helping design go-to-market structures and partnership models that are legally sound and support rapid innovation.

  • Advise leadership and stakeholders on a wide range of commercial legal matters and negotiations, including technology agreements, strategic partnerships, and terms of service.

  • Oversee the development and continuous improvement of legal templates, playbooks, AI processes, and risk management frameworks that support scalable and efficient commercial operations.

  • Collaborate closely with Compliance, Tax, and Regulatory teams to assess legal risk and implement practical, forward-thinking solutions that unlock business opportunities.

  • Support contract lifecycle management and help drive legal process automation and tooling improvements across the function.

  • Assist with M&A efforts as needed, including contract diligence and integration.

  • Additional responsibilities and special projects as assigned by the Head of Commercial Legal.

 

What you bring

  • J.D. or equivalent legal degree and active license to practice law in at least one jurisdiction.

  • 8+ years of commercial legal experience, ideally a mix of top-tier law firm and in-house experience.

  • Proven track record leading complex, high-stakes commercial transactions in a global environment, particularly those involving technology, SaaS, or strategic partnerships.

  • Deep understanding of product development and go-to-market strategies from a legal perspective.

  • Excellent contract drafting, negotiation, and analytical skills.

  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including mentoring and managing high-performing teams.

  • Ability to operate independently and decisively in a fast-paced, remote-first, innovation-driven environment.

 

Nice to haves

  • Experience in fintech, crypto, or other highly regulated sectors.

  • Familiarity with vendor onboarding, procurement processes, and compliance frameworks.

  • Background working closely with product and engineering teams to develop and launch consumer-facing and enterprise products.

  • Experience implementing or managing contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools.

  • Passion for crypto, Web3, and emerging technologies.

 
 
 

Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis.

Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution.

We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance.

Our commitment

Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto.

We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision.

As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.
